_comment: Endpoint audit config. REPORT-ONLY: the audit runs on every PR, writes .audit/endpoint-audit.json, and posts actionable Agent Server contract divergences as a PR comment, but does NOT fail CI. It uses the same exact pinned release artifact as generated types. Intentional client-ahead calls and routes exposed as authenticated URLs are documented below rather than reported as divergences. Clients for other backends must be excluded explicitly. To make either direction blocking, enable the corresponding gate below. See scripts/endpoint-audit.mjs.

allowClientOnly.reason: Operational Agent Server endpoints intentionally excluded from the filtered public release artifact.
Client-ahead API stacked on the pending Agent Server meta-profiles implementation.

coveredServerOperations.reason: RemoteWorkspace.startWorkspaceSession exposes these authenticated URLs for browser iframe and file requests; they are not HttpClient method calls.
